scenario: [RARC.5.2.6]: a slot value whose kind is the declared type enters, from a Json leaf as from anywhere. The control for `RARC.5.2.6.json_int_leaf_into_float_slot_is_a_type_error`: the same program, and the leaf written `2.5`, a Float ([LFAC.2.5.1]). `got` logs the fact that entered; `handler` would log a TypeError on `Out.v`. Exactly ["entered 2.5"]: a runtime that refused every Json leaf into a typed slot, rather than deciding by the leaf's kind, logs `handler`'s line instead, and so the sibling's refusal is shown to be the kind's. Path: libds rete/engine.c eval_actions (ds_rete_slot_refused admits it, then ds_rete_wm_assert); Mercury ds.exec.m assert_verb (ds.fact.slot_fault finds nothing).
rules_ds:
schema Payload scope logical:
    body: Json key

schema Out scope logical:
    id: String key
    v: Float mutable

rule r:
    Payload p
->
    emit Out logical id: "o" v: p.body.n

rule got:
    Out o
->
    log info "entered {o.v}"

rule handler:
    TypeError e where e.schema == "Out" and e.slot == "v"
->
    log info "refused Out.v {e.actual}"
